# book_event_webhook (Resource)

The event_webhook records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `owner_id` (String) Organization that owns this subscription
- `url` (String) The endpoint URL that will receive event callbacks

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the webhook receives deliveries. Defaults to true on create.
- `event_name` (String) Specific event to subscribe to, a built in event type or the name of an event a node in reach declares. When omitted or null, receives all events.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The signing secret, generated on create when omitted.
